anchors_checked.evidence: The public GitHub advisory page GHSA-8qx7-j2v2-x6q5 (HTTP 200, unauthenticated) renders: package gomod github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2 (Go), 'Affected versions <=v2.11.4', 'Patched versions v2.11.5', severity Low, published Oct 13, 2026, describing RFC 7230 hop-by-hop headers leaking through the reverse proxy's HTTP 101 WebSocket path because finalizeResponse returns early before stripping. The snapshot is exactly v2.11.4, and its modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/reverseproxy.go has the 101 early return at lines 1219-1224 before the hopHeaders strip loop at line 1228, i.e. genuinely pre-fix. The fix appears in v2.11.5 as commit 25b3eab6dbd8d2d2670711f26b774e0fd43e1179 ('reverseproxy: hop-by-hop header fix', 2026-06-12) which moves the hopHeaders stripping before the 101 branch. OSV returns 404 for both CVE-2026-55458 and GHSA-8qx7-j2v2-x6q5, NVD returns totalResults=0, and CVE.org returns CVE_RECORD_DNE, consistent with the packet's statement that only the repository-scoped advisory carries this range.
